audit_scope: Independent raw logs, paired statistics, input provenance and original performance gates. No training or evaluation rerun; objective-gradient mathematics independently reviewed elsewhere.

variants.refit: Previously trained unanchored balanced/normalized-objective refit, copied with matching hashes; not retrained
variants.raw-objective: New fixed-importance-corrected objective refit on the same retained replay, model initialization, fit budget and input RNG

decision_scope: Only raw-objective minus current on public, mixed and NoRegrets; all refit and heuristic comparisons remain diagnostic
checks: All 54 candidate hashes match evaluation plan and actual files; prior refit copies match originals; 158 preregistered input hashes match before and after evaluation
Every raw record covers the exact ordered deal/seat grid, planned card and hand seed, six integer zero-sum utilities, bounded payoff and step count, with no mixture iteration
Raw blocks and all 18 absolute / 18 paired comparisons independently recomputed, including every per-seed interval
Reference raw hashes, plans, traces, per-seat intervals, context counts/payoffs and aggregate hero actions verified
All paired intervals average six seats and then three model seeds inside each of the 2000 shared card blocks
Only the raw-objective candidate receives the unchanged original four-condition decision; no deployment authorization
limitations: Nominal 95% intervals condition on three fixed training seeds and are not adjusted for repeated research or multiple comparisons
NoRegrets has substantial fallback behavior; fixed public/mixed/NoRegrets opponents do not establish broad poker strength
The three rule opponents are untrained exploitable behavioral diagnostics, not independently validated strong agents
Action measures count events, may exceed one per hand, and do not establish causal explanations
Original-field raw files have no producer-provided checksum; this audit computes and records their local SHA-256 after independently rebuilding payoff blocks
Preservation flags and matched fit schedule evidence are recorded and file hashes verified; this evaluation audit does not rerun fitting or the Leduc objective gate
No game replay or six-player exploitability calculation was performed; no remote backup validation is claimed
score_units: bb per 100 hands; engine uses 100 chips per big blind, so numeric mean chips/hand equals bb/100
statistical_unit: 2000 shared card blocks per field; six hero seats then three fixed model seeds averaged within each block
findings: The correction fails both public gates: paired public lower bound is negative and only seed344 improves. Mixed and NoRegrets non-regression gates pass. Preserve the original120 campaign and do not promote this derived candidate.

Seed343 accounts for the largest public deterioration: raw-objective minus current is -464.98 bb/100; seed342 is -2.78 and seed344 is +46.00. Mixed and NoRegrets also have negative changes for seed343 while seeds342/344 improve. Averages do not establish uniform seed robustness.

Against the old refit evaluated on these same cards, the new correction is lower on public (-73.28) and mixed (-94.85), with nominal intervals below zero; NoRegrets +10.27 has an interval crossing zero. The two refit variants are distinct stored policies; the old control was not retrained.

The raw-objective policy improves against calling-station (+795.94) and pressure (+407.60), but loses against tight-value (-76.41), relative to current. These heuristic diagnostics cannot replace the failed original gates or establish broad poker strength.

Across all six fields the new policy has fewer preflop-fold events and more raise events per hand. On public, folds are70.84% versus51.30% and raise events/hand0.388 versus0.673 for current versus raw-objective. These are observed behavior differences, not causal explanations for the payoff change.
